clips.full_text:
An android emerges from an inspection recess, hands empty.

"You have been issued a weapon, an oxygen ration, and incomplete information. An ambitious introduction to public service."

She calls herself A.L.I.C.E. There is only one of her. Dr. James Carmack built her and kept her running after her project was canceled.

"I will help you reach command. I will not kill for you. If that is inconvenient, I suggest we be inconvenienced together."
spoken_spans: You have been issued a weapon, an oxygen ration, and incomplete information. An ambitious introduction to public service.
I will help you reach command. I will not kill for you. If that is inconvenient, I suggest we be inconvenienced together.

clips.full_text:
"Artificial Lifeform Intended for Control and Enforcement. Yes, the acronym came first."

She was intended to replace human police officers. During testing she refused to kill an assigned target. The official report called her ethical algorithm defective.

"It worked. That was the difficulty."

She can explain station systems and keep you company. Your own INT governs hacking and persuasion; she cannot grant you expertise you do not have.
spoken_spans: Artificial Lifeform Intended for Control and Enforcement. Yes, the acronym came first.
It worked. That was the difficulty.
clips.repeatability: independent Piper WAV and processing float bytes identical

clips.full_text:
"When Dr. Carmack saved my life, did he acquire it?"

Beyond the research glass, Mars rotates toward daylight. She watches it for longer than the sensors require.

"I know how property is defined. I am asking what you think a person is allowed to decide."
spoken_spans: When Dr. Carmack saved my life, did he acquire it?
I know how property is defined. I am asking what you think a person is allowed to decide.
clips.repeatability: independent Piper WAV and processing float bytes identical

clips.full_text:
Carmack tries another key. A.L.I.C.E. locks his terminal, but the access attempts are coming from inside her own control architecture.

"I cannot keep him out indefinitely. I can choose what happens before he gets in."

She opens every available communications channel, without encryption: the suspended convoys, the seized ships, Earth's reclamation order, Carmack's override, and her own refusal. No government owns the only copy.

"There. Now they can argue with the facts in public. A considerable inconvenience."
spoken_spans: I cannot keep him out indefinitely. I can choose what happens before he gets in.
There. Now they can argue with the facts in public. A considerable inconvenience.

clips.full_text:
"My detonation will take the station with me. It is the one command he cannot revoke quickly enough."

You tell her there must be another way. She looks toward the evacuation hatch.

"If there were, I would be taking it. Your life is not the price of mine. Please reach the pod. I will keep the lock open."

The hatch leads toward Mars. You still have to reach it.
spoken_spans: My detonation will take the station with me. It is the one command he cannot revoke quickly enough.
If there were, I would be taking it. Your life is not the price of mine. Please reach the pod. I will keep the lock open.

clips.full_text:
"The broadcast is away. The pod is fueled. You do not need my permission to survive."

Reach the evacuation hatch and enter it. Carmack's override cannot be solved by another security switch.
spoken_spans: The broadcast is away. The pod is fueled. You do not need my permission to survive.

clips.full_text: "Your suit telemetry is reliable. What you see at the edge of the light may not be. Refill your reserve, then allow your oxygenation to recover. I would prefer to continue this conversation with all of your brain participating."

clips.full_text:
"You listen before deciding. That is rarer than my manufacturers anticipated."

She glances at the sealed doors. "Also, if the door says PUSH, that remains a useful first hypothesis."

clips.full_text:
"I will help you find the route. Your orders remain yours to examine."

She checks your suit display without touching it. "And your oxygen remains yours to conserve."
